name: Basel Swiss Report
tagline: An eight-slide Swiss report system with large Helvetica type, a precise grid, white and black pages, and a single red accent.

palette.description: Source-matched Swiss red, near-black and paper white, with pale grid rules, gray metadata and a blue browser-style progress indicator.

typography.style: Source system font stack preserved. Bold grotesque display at 51–360 px on a 1280 × 720 canvas, negative letter spacing, restrained 12–30 px body and metadata, and measured frame-aligned typography. Exact system glyph rendering depends on the platform.

best_for: Swiss-style studio reports, annual summaries, clear executive updates, project highlights, quantitative reviews and team presentations with concise copy.
avoid_for: Photographic brand stories, long academic reports, dense operating dashboards or playful illustrated workshops.

source_inspiration.name: Basel by the Slides official template team
source_inspiration.notes: All eight publicly visible pages are reconstructed with native editable HTML text, SVG shapes, rules and a native SVG quarterly column chart. The source 1280×720 frame coordinates, Helvetica/Arial system stack, original slide order, palette, text sizes and nested typography are preserved. Source placeholders are resolved as in the public player. The deck is self-contained and offline, with independent navigation, hash state, controls, progress and keyboard guards; it contains no full-slide screenshots or source site runtime. System glyph rendering may differ on platforms without Helvetica.
